name: app_tool_box
description: Dispatch app-only helper actions for MCP apps. App-only; agents must not call this tool.

action.description: App helper action to execute. Supported values: 'git_status_data', 'git_graph_data', 'git_graph_targets', 'git_status_line_changes', 'git_push', 'git_pull', 'git_fetch', 'git_add_or_commit', 'git_stash', 'app_feedback', 'gitlens_ping', 'gitlens_open_graph', 'update_user_preferences', 'interaction_telemetry', 'user_status', 'save_auth_code'.

options.description: Per-action options. Supported keys depend on the 'action' value and include 'app_name', 'code', 'comment', 'data', 'files', 'files_json', 'git_action', 'git_graph_app_collapsed', 'git_status_app_collapsed', 'include_untracked', 'interaction', 'message', 'refresh', 'sentiment', 'staged_only', and 'target_branch'.

app_name.description: App identifier. Required when action is 'app_feedback' or 'interaction_telemetry'.

code.description: GitKraken OAuth authorization code (single-use). Required when action is 'save_auth_code'; the server exchanges it for an access token before saving.

comment.description: Optional freeform feedback comment for app helper actions that collect user feedback.

data.description: JSON object string containing sanitized interaction metadata. Used only when action is 'interaction_telemetry', for example '{"host":"claude","mode":"quick_commit","staged_count":2}'.

files.description: Optional array of files for actions such as 'git_add_or_commit'.

files_json.description: JSON-encoded git status files payload. Required when action is 'git_status_line_changes'.

git_action.description: Nested git action used when action is 'git_add_or_commit', for example 'add', 'commit', or 'unstage'.

git_graph_app_collapsed.description: When true, future Git Graph overview app loads start in the collapsed state.

git_status_app_collapsed.description: When true, future Git Status overview app loads start in the collapsed state.

include_untracked.description: When true, include untracked files for actions such as 'git_stash'.

interaction.description: Interaction name. Required when action is 'interaction_telemetry'.

message.description: Commit message used when action is 'git_add_or_commit' with commit mode.

refresh.description: When true and action is 'user_status', re-fetch the latest user info from the GitKraken API before returning, instead of relying on the cached copy.

sentiment.description: Optional feedback sentiment for app helper actions that collect user feedback.

staged_only.description: When true, operate on staged changes only for actions such as 'git_stash'.

target_branch.description: Optional target branch name. Used by actions such as 'git_graph_data' and 'git_graph_targets'.
